name: south

attributes.attribute: the direction opposite to the solar cycle toward the sun
named deosil in Irish, meaning to move with the order of nature
province linked to poetry, song, women, and the feminine

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: South is a direction in the old sacred geography of Ireland. It stands opposed to the turn of the solar cycle, for in the north the sun always moves toward the south from dawn to noon. South is deosil in Irish, a word that also means to move with the natural order. The southwestern province of Munster carries some of the weight of that direction. Munster stands for poetry and for song. It is the province most tied to women and the feminine. To go south is to move with the sun and with the turning of the world.
